Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: If cars are passing you on both sides while you drive in the center lane of an expressway, what should you do?

options_en.text: Stay in the center lane.
Move to the right lane.
Move to the left lane.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: When is it safe to return to your lane after passing another vehicle?

options_en.text: When you cannot see the vehicle to your right.
When you see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
When you have passed the vehicle's front bumper.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What should you do when passing on a two-lane road?

options_en.text: Sound your horn as you pass.
Flash your headlights as you pass.
Check the distance to any oncoming vehicles.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: How can you help the driver behind you stay at a safe distance?

options_en.text: Drive 10 mph faster than the car behind you.
Drive 10 mph slower than the car behind you.
Drive at a steady speed.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: Which of these is a safe driving technique?

options_en.text: Using your high beam lights in fog.
Staring straight ahead at the road.
Checking your rearview mirrors regularly.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What should you do when driving in fog?

options_en.text: Turn on your high beam headlights.
Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Speed up to avoid an accident.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: Traffic on the freeway is merging into your lane. What should you do?

options_en.text: Make room for the merging traffic if you can.
Speed up to keep your spot.
Always stay in your position.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: After passing a vehicle, when is it safe to move back to the right lane?

options_en.text: After about three seconds.
When you can no longer see the passed vehicle over your right shoulder.
When you can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: How can you avoid skidding on slippery surfaces?

options_en.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up to enter curves and slow down to exit them.
Slow down before entering curves and intersections.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: Why should you signal continuously while turning?

options_en.text: It is illegal to turn off your signal before completing a turn.
It tells other drivers what you plan to do.
It is always unsafe to turn off a signal before completing a turn.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What should you do when driving in work zones?

options_en.text: Follow the driver in front of you closely.
Pass the driver in front of you as soon as you can.
Do not tailgate and keep a safe distance from other vehicles.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What is the proper way to make a right turn?

options_en.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the centerline before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach the corner in the right lane, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: As your speed increases, what is important to do?

options_en.text: Turn on your headlights.
Look ahead of your vehicle.
Change lanes frequently.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: You exit the freeway on a curved ramp that goes downhill. What should you do?

options_en.text: Slow to a safe speed before the curve.
Slow to the posted freeway speed limit.
Start braking after you enter the curve.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: At intersections, crosswalks, and railroad crossings, you should always:

options_en.text: Stop, listen, and proceed carefully.
Look to the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Slowly pass vehicles that appear to be stopped for no reason.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: Sharp right turn ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options_en.text: Stop before crossing the intersection.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Wait for a green light before proceeding.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: When driving in fog, what lights should you use?

options_en.text: Use your high beam headlights.
Use your parking lights.
Use your low beam headlights.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What happens if you brake hard continuously on ice and snow?

options_en.text: Helps you stop faster.
Locks the front wheels, causing you to lose steering control.
Keeps the brakes from freezing.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: How can you prevent hydroplaning in rainy weather?

options_en.text: Put on your cruise control to maintain a constant speed.
Slow down.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it starts to rain.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: A school bus ahead has flashing red lights. What should you do?

options_en.text: Stop and go when you think all children have exited.
Slow to 25 mph and pass carefully.
Stop until the red lights stop flashing.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What does a yellow left turn arrow mean?

options_en.text: Be ready to yield to oncoming traffic.
The protected left turn is ending.
Both of the above.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: When are streets and highways most slippery?

options_en.text: When it has been raining hard for several hours.
When they are clean and dry.
Just after it starts to rain.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: On a slippery road, what following distance should you maintain?

options_en.text: No different than normal.
Farther from the car ahead than normal.
Closer to the car ahead than normal.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: When should you yield your right-of-way?

options_en.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
Never. It confuses other drivers.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: On a one-way street, when can you turn left onto another one-way street?

options_en.text: If you increase your speed before the turn.
If traffic on that street moves to the right.
If traffic on that street moves to the left.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: Why is winter driving more dangerous?

options_en.text: Ice, snow, fog, and freezing temperatures make roads unsafe.
There are more hours of darkness.
Both of the above.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
U-turns are prohibited.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: Can you drive off the road to pass another vehicle?

options_en.text: Yes, if the vehicle ahead is turning left.
Yes, if there are two or more lanes in your direction.
No, never.

Fines, Points, & Violations Quiz 2.question_en: What problems can strong wind gusts cause on highways?

options_en.text: They affect only large vehicles.
They only reduce visibility.
They can affect all vehicles.
